global_comparison_contract: Preserve native values, units and definitions; any normalized display is an additional, versioned derived representation.
Compare two values only when the indicator definition, unit, denominator, geographic/population boundary, time window and relevant method versions match.
For intensity metrics, display the absolute numerator as well; a falling intensity can coexist with rising absolute pressure.
Keep social deprivation, ecological condition/overshoot, monetary flows, energy flows and material flows distinct.
Missing, not collected, below detection limit, suppressed, not applicable and not computable are different states and must not be coerced to zero.
Targets are normative inputs, observations are empirical records, derived indicators are calculations, and interpretation is inference; store them separately.
Candidate definitions are not claims that a dataset exists, that the indicator is implemented, or that any outcome has improved.
For laboratory studies, keep small-sample studies separate from continuous-monitoring time series; sample counts and study windows must travel with each comparison.

indicators.title: Basic-needs deprivation share
indicators.definition: Share of the explicitly defined population that fails one or more locally specified basic-needs thresholds. Preserve each component alongside any stated combined calculation.
indicators.native_unit: fraction_of_population (0-1) or percent_of_population (0-100); choose one per series
indicators.denominator: Resident population in the stated geography and reference period; document age/household exclusions.
indicators.spatial_scope_required: Named geography plus population definition
indicators.temporal_resolution_required: Reference period and observation date
indicators.baseline_and_target: Store observed baseline separately from normative target; identify the authority and date for each threshold.
indicators.uncertainty_required: Sampling and coverage uncertainty; list excluded populations and subgroup coverage.
indicators.missing_data_rule: missing_or_unknown; never substitute zero or classify missing groups as meeting the threshold
caveats: Do not combine dimensions with opaque weights.
A place-specific threshold is not automatically comparable across places.

indicators.title: Ecosystem extent by type
indicators.definition: Area of each explicitly classified ecosystem type inside a declared accounting boundary at a stated time; changes require consistent classification and boundary handling.
indicators.native_unit: hectares (ha) or square kilometres (km2); one unit per series
indicators.denominator: Absolute area; optional share of defined accounting area as a separate derived series.
indicators.spatial_scope_required: Versioned spatial boundary and ecosystem classification
indicators.temporal_resolution_required: Observation/reference date plus classification epoch
indicators.baseline_and_target: Record reference extent and any desired/reference condition; do not infer that every ecosystem type should maximize its area.
indicators.uncertainty_required: Classification error, map resolution, and boundary uncertainty
indicators.missing_data_rule: unknown_for_unmapped_or_unclassified_area; report coverage explicitly
caveats: Extent is not ecosystem condition or quality.
An increase in one ecosystem type can coincide with loss of another.

indicators.title: Ecosystem condition profile
indicators.definition: A profile of selected condition variables for each ecosystem type compared with a documented reference level; keep native variables visible rather than assuming a universal composite.
indicators.native_unit: variable-specific native units; no common unit for the profile
indicators.denominator: Defined ecosystem asset/type, sampling frame, and accounting area
indicators.spatial_scope_required: Spatially explicit ecosystem assets and sampling sites
indicators.temporal_resolution_required: Sampling date/season and repeat interval
indicators.baseline_and_target: Reference levels and target bands must be versioned per ecosystem type and variable.
indicators.uncertainty_required: Measurement error, sampling design, reference-condition uncertainty and confidence intervals where available
indicators.missing_data_rule: unknown_per_variable; no blank-to-zero conversion or implicit composite
caveats: Condition is multidimensional; an aggregate requires explicit weights and sensitivity analysis.
Monetary ecosystem value is not a substitute for biophysical condition.

indicators.title: Physical ecosystem-service flow
indicators.definition: Physical supply of a named ecosystem service by ecosystem assets and its use by named beneficiaries/economic units during the same accounting period.
indicators.native_unit: service-specific physical unit; never assume services share a unit
indicators.denominator: Named ecosystem assets, beneficiary units, and accounting boundary
indicators.spatial_scope_required: Provider asset and beneficiary/use geography
indicators.temporal_resolution_required: Common accounting period for supply and use
indicators.baseline_and_target: Record demand, sustainable/reference supply assumptions and target rationale separately.
indicators.uncertainty_required: Source-model uncertainty, attribution and spatial transfer assumptions
indicators.missing_data_rule: unknown_for_unobserved_flows; do not infer no service from absent accounting
caveats: Supply/use does not itself prove equitable access or ecosystem sustainability.
Monetary valuation is optional and cannot replace physical quantities.

indicators.title: Absolute territorial greenhouse-gas emissions
indicators.definition: Total territorial greenhouse-gas emissions for a stated inventory boundary, gases, sectors and reporting period, using a declared inventory standard and global-warming-potential version.
indicators.native_unit: tonnes CO2-equivalent per reporting period (tCO2e/period)
indicators.denominator: No denominator: absolute total
indicators.spatial_scope_required: Inventory geography and sector boundary
indicators.temporal_resolution_required: Annual or explicitly defined inventory period
indicators.baseline_and_target: Store base year, restatements and target separately; preserve absolute total when also reporting intensity.
indicators.uncertainty_required: Inventory uncertainty and method/revision metadata
indicators.missing_data_rule: unknown_if_inventory_missing_or_incomplete; show coverage
caveats: Do not confuse territorial and consumption-based emissions.
Do not infer an absolute decline from an intensity decline.

indicators.title: Territorial greenhouse-gas emissions per capita
indicators.definition: Territorial greenhouse-gas inventory total divided by a population estimate with matching geography and period; show the absolute inventory alongside it.
indicators.native_unit: tCO2e per person per year (tCO2e/person/year)
indicators.denominator: Resident population estimate with declared reference date/method
indicators.spatial_scope_required: Same inventory geography and compatible population geography
indicators.temporal_resolution_required: Matching annual inventory and population period
indicators.baseline_and_target: Record baseline, population source, and target authority; never replace absolute-emissions series.
indicators.uncertainty_required: Propagate inventory and population uncertainty when material
indicators.missing_data_rule: unknown_if_either_numerator_or_denominator_is_missing; reject zero/invalid denominator
caveats: Per-capita declines can coexist with rising absolute emissions.
Territorial per-capita figures are not consumption footprints.

indicators.title: Pollutant-specific water quality
indicators.definition: Concentration or indicator value for a named pollutant/organism at a declared monitoring location and depth using a specified sampling and laboratory protocol.
indicators.native_unit: pollutant-specific unit (for example mg/L); never combine unlike pollutants without an explicit method
indicators.denominator: Sample volume or protocol-defined measurement basis
indicators.spatial_scope_required: Water body, monitoring station, sampling depth and catchment context
indicators.temporal_resolution_required: Sample date, season and sampling frequency
indicators.baseline_and_target: Attach jurisdictional/ecological threshold, legal status and version as separate fields.
indicators.uncertainty_required: Detection limit, lab method, sampling uncertainty and quality flags
indicators.missing_data_rule: below_detection_limit_is_censored_not_zero; absent sample is unknown
caveats: A single station or pollutant is not a complete water-health assessment.
Thresholds can vary by ecosystem, use and jurisdiction.

indicators.title: Soil organic carbon stock
indicators.definition: Soil organic carbon stock estimated for a specified soil depth, area, bulk-density and coarse-fragment protocol, with repeated sampling under a consistent method.
indicators.native_unit: tonnes of carbon per hectare for a stated depth (t C/ha, depth specified)
indicators.denominator: Sampled land area; profile depth and soil mass convention must be recorded
indicators.spatial_scope_required: Field/site polygon and sampling design
indicators.temporal_resolution_required: Sample date/season and repeat interval
indicators.baseline_and_target: Use site-specific baseline and comparable repeated measures; disclose stock-change model if used.
indicators.uncertainty_required: Sampling and analytical uncertainty, bulk density and depth corrections
indicators.missing_data_rule: unknown_if_sampling_or_conversion_inputs_missing; estimated values must be labeled
caveats: Carbon concentration is not the same as carbon stock or verified sequestration.
Short time series can be dominated by spatial and measurement noise.

indicators.title: Soil water infiltration rate
indicators.definition: Rate at which water infiltrates into soil under a specified instrument, pre-wetting, soil-moisture state and protocol.
indicators.native_unit: millimetres per hour (mm/h)
indicators.denominator: Surface area and test duration according to the selected protocol
indicators.spatial_scope_required: Field/site and sampling locations
indicators.temporal_resolution_required: Sample date, preceding weather and soil moisture state
indicators.baseline_and_target: Compare repeated measurements with matched protocol and seasonal context.
indicators.uncertainty_required: Replicate variance, instrument resolution and spatial sampling uncertainty
indicators.missing_data_rule: unknown_if_protocol_or_context_is_missing; do not impute from management practice
caveats: Higher infiltration is not universally better under all site conditions.
A single test does not demonstrate watershed-scale outcomes.

indicators.title: Native taxon occupancy or abundance
indicators.definition: Occupancy, encounter rate or abundance for a declared native taxon/group under an explicit protocol; keep raw observations and detection assumptions available.
indicators.native_unit: taxon- and protocol-specific count, occupancy fraction or index
indicators.denominator: Sample sites, sampling effort or eligible area; explicitly state which
indicators.spatial_scope_required: Survey frame, habitat/ecosystem type and locations
indicators.temporal_resolution_required: Survey dates, season and repeat interval
indicators.baseline_and_target: Use a documented reference condition and site/ecoregion context; no universal target for every taxon.
indicators.uncertainty_required: Detection probability, sampling effort and identification confidence
indicators.missing_data_rule: non-detection_is_not_absence_without_detection_model; no survey means unknown
caveats: Species richness alone can hide losses of abundance, composition or endemic taxa.
Do not pool incompatible survey protocols into one score.

indicators.title: Material footprint per capita
indicators.definition: Material footprint attributed to a population/economy under the chosen material-flow-accounting method divided by a compatible population estimate.
indicators.native_unit: tonnes per person per year, with material categories stated (t/person/year)
indicators.denominator: Resident population or explicitly selected population basis
indicators.spatial_scope_required: Economy/consumption boundary and included material categories
indicators.temporal_resolution_required: Annual account period
indicators.baseline_and_target: Keep total footprint, category breakdown and per-capita series; state target scope and method.
indicators.uncertainty_required: Input-output/embodied-flow model uncertainty and revision metadata
indicators.missing_data_rule: unknown_if_flow_account_is_incomplete; do not treat unaccounted imported materials as zero
caveats: Per-capita measures can improve while total throughput rises.
Material footprint is not interchangeable with domestic material consumption.

indicators.title: Virgin material input
indicators.definition: Mass of virgin material entering the stated system boundary during a period, segmented by material category and origin where feasible.
indicators.native_unit: tonnes per period (t/period), by material category
indicators.denominator: Absolute mass; optional intensity is a separately named derived indicator
indicators.spatial_scope_required: System boundary, material categories and origin/import rules
indicators.temporal_resolution_required: Accounting period and inventory date
indicators.baseline_and_target: Keep absolute quantities; define any target and separate intensity metrics.
indicators.uncertainty_required: Mass-balance coverage, estimation uncertainty and data gaps
indicators.missing_data_rule: unknown_for_untraced_flows; report unclassified fraction
caveats: Lower input is not inherently beneficial if essential service provision or wellbeing collapses.
Virgin input must be read alongside service demand, durability and stocks.

indicators.title: Product material circularity
indicators.definition: A product-level circularity metric calculated using the exact documented version of a named tool (for example the Material Circularity Indicator), its inputs and assumptions.
indicators.native_unit: tool-defined dimensionless score; preserve tool/version and component values
indicators.denominator: Product or explicitly described product portfolio; not automatically economy-wide
indicators.spatial_scope_required: Product bill-of-materials and stated product boundary
indicators.temporal_resolution_required: Design/data snapshot date and assessment period
indicators.baseline_and_target: Store tool version, baseline product design and target separately.
indicators.uncertainty_required: Bill-of-materials coverage, end-of-life assumptions and input estimates
indicators.missing_data_rule: not_computable_if_required_inputs_missing; never default missing material fractions to zero
caveats: Product score is not a system-level circularity measure.
MCI tool status and method compatibility should be rechecked before operational use.

indicators.title: Repair, reuse and remanufacturing share
indicators.definition: Mass or item count routed to clearly distinguished repair, direct reuse, refurbishment, remanufacturing and recycling pathways divided by a declared eligible flow; each pathway remains separately reported.
indicators.native_unit: fraction or percent of a declared eligible flow; mass-based and item-based series must not mix
indicators.denominator: Explicit eligible product/material flow entering the system
indicators.spatial_scope_required: Product/material system boundary and waste hierarchy stage
indicators.temporal_resolution_required: Accounting period and product-cohort window where relevant
indicators.baseline_and_target: Record pathway-specific baseline and policy/measurement definitions.
indicators.uncertainty_required: Tracing coverage, mass-balance discrepancies, pathway classification uncertainty
indicators.missing_data_rule: unknown_for_untraced_flow; publish traced and untraced fractions
caveats: Do not collapse repair/reuse/remanufacturing/recycling into one unqualified rate.
Higher circular share does not establish lower absolute extraction or pollution.

indicators.title: Waste generation per capita
indicators.definition: Mass of waste generated under an explicit waste classification and system boundary divided by a matching population estimate.
indicators.native_unit: kilograms per person per year (kg/person/year)
indicators.denominator: Resident population or explicitly stated service population
indicators.spatial_scope_required: Waste-generation boundary, included sectors and collection coverage
indicators.temporal_resolution_required: Annual period and population reference date
indicators.baseline_and_target: Keep absolute waste generation, treatment route and per-capita series together.
indicators.uncertainty_required: Uncollected/illegal disposal estimate uncertainty and classification gaps
indicators.missing_data_rule: unknown_for_unmeasured_or_uncollected_flows; display coverage
caveats: Waste collected is not necessarily waste generated.
Lower reported amounts can reflect weaker collection or measurement, not prevention.

indicators.title: Agricultural yield stability
indicators.definition: Variability of yield for a defined crop, field/system, harvest basis and time series; publish mean, observation count and variability statistic rather than a stability score alone.
indicators.native_unit: coefficient of variation (dimensionless) plus native yield unit and mean
indicators.denominator: Matched crop/area/harvest definition for every included season
indicators.spatial_scope_required: Farm/field boundary, crop and management system
indicators.temporal_resolution_required: Seasonal/yearly series and sufficiently long time window
indicators.baseline_and_target: Baseline and intervention comparison require matched weather, crop, area and observation window or explicit controls.
indicators.uncertainty_required: Sample count, interannual variation, weather confounding and missing seasons
indicators.missing_data_rule: not_estimated_below_declared_minimum_observations; no interpolation without a labeled method
caveats: Low variability may coexist with low yield or degraded soil.
Practice adoption is not outcome evidence; causal claims need a design appropriate to the question.

indicators.title: Finn Cycling Index (flow-network cycling)
indicators.definition: Flow-network cycling measure computed from a fully declared, bounded and typed flow matrix using a specific published implementation/version; retain matrix, boundary and preprocessing receipt.
indicators.native_unit: dimensionless ratio under the selected formulation; report exact equation/version
indicators.denominator: Defined system throughput/flow quantity per metric specification
indicators.spatial_scope_required: Explicit nodes, boundary, internal/external flows and node classification
indicators.temporal_resolution_required: Flow matrix interval and aggregation window
indicators.baseline_and_target: Compare only same network boundary, equation and flow-accounting convention.
indicators.uncertainty_required: Input flow measurement error, incomplete flows and matrix sensitivity
indicators.missing_data_rule: not_computable_if_matrix_is_incomplete_or_boundary_is_ambiguous; do not infer zeros
caveats: A high cycling index alone does not prove ecological or social benefit.
Financial transfers cannot substitute for energy/material/care flows without an explicit model.

indicators.title: Energy-network structure and vitality profile
indicators.definition: A profile of the exact energy-network metrics used by a named method (for example aggradation, diversity, mutualism or vitality-window measures); each metric must have its own formula, network boundary and native unit.
indicators.native_unit: metric-specific; no universal unit for the profile
indicators.denominator: Network nodes, flows, throughflow or other equation-specific basis
indicators.spatial_scope_required: Bounded network, node classes and flow categories
indicators.temporal_resolution_required: Flow interval, aggregation window and network revision
indicators.baseline_and_target: Use reference distributions or explicit thresholds with a rationale; do not infer a universal optimum.
indicators.uncertainty_required: Matrix completeness, parameter sensitivity and model-structure uncertainty
indicators.missing_data_rule: unknown_or_not_computable_if_contract_incomplete; no composite until component definitions are frozen
caveats: The socioeconomic interpretation of ecological network indicators needs domain-specific validation.
Avoid collapsing efficiency, resilience, diversity and mutualism into an opaque score.

indicators.title: Freshwater physicochemical profile
indicators.definition: A typed profile of sample-level measurements such as pH, temperature, electrical conductivity, total dissolved solids, turbidity and alkalinity. Each variable is a separate series with its own unit, method, sample matrix, sampling context and site/time.
indicators.native_unit: Variable-specific (e.g. pH dimensionless, temperature °C, electrical conductivity µS/cm or µS/m, TDS mg/L, turbidity NTU); no single composite unit.
indicators.denominator: Use each variable's native measurement basis. For concentration-like variables retain sampled volume and exact unit; do not normalize unlike physical quantities to a shared denominator.
indicators.spatial_scope_required: Station/site identifier, coordinates or boundary, water body/catchment and sampling point (e.g. upstream/downstream).
indicators.temporal_resolution_required: Exact sample/collection timestamp, timezone when known, season and sampling interval.
indicators.baseline_and_target: Record reference period and applicable parameter-specific guideline with issuing authority, water-use class and version. Do not treat generic directionality as a threshold.
indicators.uncertainty_required: Field/lab method, calibration, detection or reporting limits, replicate/sampling variability and quality flags.
input_requirements: sample matrix and depth when relevant
indicators.missing_data_rule: No sample is unknown, not zero; non-detects retain censoring and limits; invalid measurements retain a quality flag instead of being silently removed.
caveats: pH, conductivity, turbidity and TDS are not interchangeable signals.
A profile is not a water-safety certification or a single score.
Upstream/downstream differences in a small study are not automatically causal effects.

indicators.title: Microbiological contamination and indicator organisms
indicators.definition: A series for a named organism, indicator group, assay or genetic marker measured in a defined water sample. Keep culture counts, MPN/CFU, molecular copies, detection status and antibiotic-susceptibility classifications distinct.
indicators.native_unit: Method-specific (e.g. MPN/100 mL, CFU/100 mL, copies per stated volume, detection status with assay limits, or susceptibility category).
indicators.denominator: Sample volume, replicate scheme and assay-specific reporting basis.
indicators.spatial_scope_required: Water body, station, upstream/downstream location, coordinates and sampling frame.
indicators.temporal_resolution_required: Exact sample timestamp and repeated-sampling interval; preserve collection and lab analysis dates separately.
indicators.baseline_and_target: Any action threshold must name organism/marker, water-use class, guideline authority and version; resistance categories use their own laboratory standard.
indicators.uncertainty_required: Method sensitivity/specificity where available, detection limit, replicate/sample count, lab protocol and contamination controls.
indicators.missing_data_rule: Not-tested, not-detected and missing are different states; a missing lab result is not a negative; values below detection retain censoring.
caveats: A small number of grab samples cannot establish long-term or city-wide safety.
Presence/absence, organism counts, molecular markers and antimicrobial resistance are different metrics.

indicators.title: Toxic-element concentration in freshwater
indicators.definition: A sample-level concentration series for one named element or analyte measured by a declared laboratory method; dissolved and total concentrations and different chemical forms remain distinct.
indicators.native_unit: Analyte-specific mass/volume unit (e.g. µg/L or mg/L); no shared unit across reported analytes.
indicators.denominator: Sample volume and the precise dissolved/total/chemical-fraction definition.
indicators.spatial_scope_required: Water body, site/station, coordinates, upstream/downstream position and sample matrix.
indicators.temporal_resolution_required: Exact sample timestamp and laboratory analysis date.
indicators.baseline_and_target: Keep numeric observations separate from threshold comparisons. Every threshold must specify analyte, matrix, water-use class, issuing authority and version.
indicators.uncertainty_required: Instrument/method, calibration, detection and quantification limits, blank/replicate information, and measurement uncertainty.
indicators.missing_data_rule: Unmeasured and below-detection-limit values are not zero; preserve censoring, qualifier codes and blank/invalid sample states.
caveats: Concentrations from a small study do not establish catchment-wide exposure or causal source attribution.
Threshold exceedance depends on the named intended water use and applicable standard.
